name: Trey McBride

background.fact: Born November 22, 1999; grew up in Fort Morgan, Colorado, and attended Fort Morgan High School, where he played baseball, basketball and football.
As a high school junior he had 32 catches for 751 yards and 11 touchdowns (Class 3A All-Colorado); he holds the school's career records for basketball points, baseball home runs and runs batted in.
He was a three-star recruit who chose Colorado State; in 2021 he won the John Mackey Award as the nation's best tight end and was a unanimous All-American, with 90 catches for 1,121 yards.
Arizona drafted him in the second round (55th overall) in 2022; listed at 6 ft 4 in, 246 lb, age 26, fifth NFL season, jersey 85.

outlook_next_game.lean: plays, heavy target volume, modest yards; expected around 8 to 12 fantasy points
reasons: He is healthy, a team captain and the clear top pass catcher with Wilson, Bourne and others out, so 8 to 13 targets is likely (he has had 8 to 13 every game).
The Rams defense is strong against tight ends (0.73 of normal points) and the total is only 38.5, with Arizona implied near 14.5 points, so touchdown chances are lower than average.
A rookie quarterback in his first start may check down more, which helps catch counts but cuts yards, as in Week 9 (54 yards) and the Week 6 Rams game (53 yards).
Risks are a blowout, a scoring drought, or extra Rams attention; upside is a red zone target, since he had 20 inside the 20.

scouts_read: McBride is healthy and is the most reliable part of a weakened Arizona offense. With Wilson and Bourne out and a rookie quarterback making his first start, he should be the first read on many throws, and his 8 to 13 targets in every game this year support a floor of five or six catches. The caution is quality: the Rams allow few tight end points, the game total is under 40, and his last two games produced 72 and 54 yards on low separation. I would project a catch heavy game of about 70 yards, with a touchdown chance near one in three given his red zone usage, for a likely 8 to 12 fantasy points.
